notes: These provisional bounds describe this local process, not measured GitHub or organization capacity.
The existing GOGREEN controller owns regime classification; this adapter never promotes a regime.
An advisory snapshot requires UTC freshness, complete scope and a matching configured repo/source_sha cohort.
Snapshot worker_slots, running and reserved_capacity must describe the same worker-slot pool.
Read/write paths are declared local leases; other processes, hosts and undeclared writes are not controlled.
Registered handlers and validators own their side effects, subprocess timeouts and output semantics.
The adapter has no remote dispatch transport, persistent leases, automatic retries or autonomous schedule.
